currentContext.expansion: Expansion in FY26 was corporate and geographic rather than physical - this is an asset-light services business with no plants and no capacity disclosure. The Company incorporated a wholly-owned subsidiary, Accelerate Next Inc (Wyoming, USA), on September 17, 2025 as a US holding company, and Accelerate Next Inc then acquired 100% of Beanstalk Web Solutions LLC (St. Louis, Missouri), which became a step-down subsidiary on March 06, 2026 (IST); the Chairman's Message dates the acquisition's finalisation to March 5, 2026. Beanstalk, described as having a decade-long track record and over 250 active mid-market clients, becomes the Group's primary onshore sales and marketing engine, adding SEO, pay-per-click advertising and social media practices alongside the existing technical offering, while the Indian facilities are repositioned as a Global Capability Center delivering DXP, AI and accessibility work. Management states the acquisition lifts the pro-forma group revenue run-rate to an estimated INR 22-25 crore and that North American projects are already transitioning to the offshore delivery teams. The other expansion track is product build-out rather than plant build-out: Beanstalk's Governance Studio (a digital governance hub covering the full lifecycle of WCAG 2.2 AA and AI readiness audits in a single desktop application) is now integrated, and Getivity, an in-house developed AI-native SaaS time-tracking platform, awaits public launch. Delivery capacity is described only through headcount - employee strength as of March 31, 2026 was 47 - and through the ISO 27001-certified Information Security Management System that governs the unified global project template. The Board's Report records no material changes or commitments affecting the financial position between the year-end and the date of the report, and no change in share capital during the year.
